sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 338)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, South African Springbok Radio, and syndication, three gripping South African flying squad investigations on *Squad Cars* for General Motors (1969–1980), Colonel Stoopnagle & Budd's hilarious gadget demonstrations for Schlitz Beer (1934), Mutual's suspense drama *Crisis* (1974), and Robert Ripley on *Ripley's Believe It or Not* for Fleischmann's Yeast (1934–1980):
